newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Command announcement likely next week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Command announcement likely next week.

text.p: Oil producer Command Petroleum Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was likely to make an announcement on or near October 1 in regards to its current merger negotiations.
"We hope to make an announcement on or about October 1," said Bun Hung, general manager of commercial, legal and administration at Command.
"We want to get the shares restated as soon as we can, we don't like them being like this," Hung told Reuters.
However, he said the relisting of Command shares would also depend on the outcome of the current merger talks.
Command is 32.64 percent owned by Snyder Oil Corp.
Brokers said a Command/Synder merger was unlikely.
Command shares were suspended earlier on Wednesday, after closing four cents stronger to 97 cents on Tuesday. The shares have more than doubled in the past six months.
The Sydney-based oil group, operator of the Ravva field off the coast of India, has a market capitalisation of A$312.60 million based on the current share price.
